articles.summary: The combined bank will remain listed in Milan, with the French lender adding Banco BPM will be "at the heart" of the new entity.

articles.title: Crédit Agricole proposes Banco BPM merger, 20% premium and €1 bln dividend
articles.summary: Investing.com -- Crédit Agricole proposed merging its Italian unit into Banco BPM, a deal that would lift its stake in the Milan-listed lender to about 45% from 29.6% without a mandatory takeover offer, and offered Banco BPM shareholders a 20% valuation premium and a €1 billion special dividend.
